topic_zh: 用 Rust 调 HTTP API（reqwest + serde）
topic_en: Calling an HTTP API from Rust with reqwest and serde

xhs.title: Rust 怎么调接口拿 JSON？
xhs.body:
第 20 课（Rust 系列最后一课）：用 reqwest + serde 调 HTTP API
cargo add reqwest --features blocking,json，再 cargo add serde --features derive
照着 JSON 写一个结构体，加 #[derive(Deserialize)]，字段名要和 JSON 的键一样
Client::new().get(网址).header("User-Agent", …).send()?.json()? 一条链拿到结构体
多出来的字段直接忽略；类型不对会返回 Err，不会悄悄给你错的值
考考你：JSON 里的键是 stargazers_count，结构体字段却写成 stars: u32，.json() 是 A 拿到 121083，还是 B 返回 Err？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Fetch JSON from a real API in Rust, in one minute: reqwest + serde. Quick quiz: the JSON key is stargazers_count but your struct field is stars: u32. A: you get 121083, or B: Err? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Calling an HTTP API from Rust in about 10 lines
linkedin.body:
Add two crates: reqwest (features blocking, json) and serde (feature derive).
Write a struct shaped like the JSON and add #[derive(Deserialize)]; field names must match the keys.
Client::new().get(url).header("User-Agent", ...).send()?.json()? gives you the struct directly.
Extra JSON fields are ignored; a wrong type returns an Err instead of a silently wrong value.
This wraps up our 20-lesson Rust series.
Quick quiz: the JSON key is stargazers_count but the struct field is stars: u32. A: you get 121083, or B: Err? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: JSON 的键是 stargazers_count，结构体字段写成 stars: u32，.json() 的结果是 A 拿到 121083，还是 B 返回 Err？
quiz.q_en: The JSON key is stargazers_count, but the struct field is stars: u32. Does .json() A: give 121083, or B: return an Err?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：B，返回 Err：missing field `stars`。serde 按字段名找 JSON 的键，找不到就报错。想用别的名字，加 #[serde(rename = "stargazers_count")]。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: B, an Err: missing field `stars`. serde matches field names to JSON keys and fails when one is missing. To use another name, add #[serde(rename = "stargazers_count")].
